headline: Sales edge up while profit slips from the prior quarter
summary_short: Revenue was SEK 36,060M, up 2.8% q/q, while operating income fell 13.0% to SEK 3,850M and EPS fell 11.9% to SEK 3.47.
summary_long: EBITDA slipped 1.6% q/q to SEK 6,178M and net income fell 12.5% to SEK 2,346M. Gross profit was SEK 10,834M versus SEK 11,446M in the prior quarter, down 5.3%. No year-over-year comparison is on the shard. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
